fact: The World Bank's Burundi Digital Economy Assessment states that there is no overarching digital economy strategy beyond the ICT policy PNDTIC 2010-2025, which lacks an actionable operational plan, and recommends adopting a new overarching strategic vision; the document gives no date beyond its 2020 publication year, which is used here.

The World Bank's Burundi Digital Economy Assessment states that the country lacks an overarching and cohesive digital strategy and recommends that the government adopt a national digital strategy as a pillar of its development plan; the document gives no date beyond its 2020 publication year, which is used here.
The Burundi Council of Ministers, meeting on 14 October 2026, recorded the adoption of the draft (projet de) National Digital Policy, according to the Primature's communique.
